Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles and drones

Saudi Arabia's coalition forces intercepted Houthi missiles and drones launched toward the country, including one aimed at Riyadh. The Saudi Pro League postponed three matches due to "logistical considerations" and rest periods. Some reports noted that Saudi Arabia's warning system remained silent before deadly airport strikes, and that skies over the capital were empty after these attacks.
